📋 Your First Two Weeks

Getting Started: What to Do Now

STEP 1 — TODAY

Login & Take the Introduction

STEP 2 — THIS WEEK

Complete the Two Assessments

STEP 3 — BY END OF NEXT WEEK

📊 Chart of the Week

The Zero-Click Future

93%

of Google AI Mode queries result in zero clicks

Google AI Mode has 75M daily active users processing 1B+ queries monthly. Users get answers directly — they don't click through. But here's the flip: sites that are cited in AI Overviews see 14.2% conversion rates vs 2.8% for organic results. The game has changed from ranking to citation.

Source: SparkToro / Datos Research, May 2026
